ranking_rule: Ranked by user harm first, then legal/store exposure, then wasted surface. No fixes were applied in this pass.

gaps.title: Play listing advertises 'crypto and investing launchers' that do not exist
gaps.evidence: appRegistry.ts categories are beauty, entertainment, fashion, food, gig, jobs, payments, quickcommerce, rides, services, shopping, social. No crypto or investing category or tile exists.
gaps.risk: Google Play policy: store listing must not describe features the app lacks. Also a financial-services claim, which Play treats strictly.
options: Remove the phrase from the Play listing (no code change)
Add a crypto/investing category to Plug (business decision: which providers)

gaps.title: Play says Ride Genie 'compares ride options across nine providers'; the backend serves a static rate card
gaps.evidence: supabase/functions/estimate-fares/index.ts header: fares come 'from a static rate card'. The website wording ('fare estimates across providers, then open the right app to book') is accurate; the Play wording is not.
gaps.risk: Misleading price claim in a store listing.
options: Align the Play copy with the site copy (recommended, free)
Integrate live provider pricing (paid APIs — owner decision)

gaps.title: 'Live weather' is advertised but /app/weather has zero inbound links
gaps.evidence: Route + weather.functions.ts exist; grep finds no link to /app/weather anywhere in src.
gaps.risk: Advertised feature is effectively absent for every user.
gaps.fix_shape: Add one Plug/home entry point, or drop the claim.

gaps.title: Food ordering is unreachable AND has an empty catalogue
gaps.evidence: No link to /app/food in src; restaurants=0, menu_items=0, orders=0 rows.
gaps.risk: Dead code carrying a money path (place_order RPC) with no oversight.
options: Retire the world and its tables
Seed a catalogue and surface it

gaps.title: profiles_select_public_columns exposes is_admin and oniq_pay_enabled to every logged-in user
gaps.evidence: Active scanner finding profiles_full_row_exposure; policy USING (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL) covers all columns.
gaps.risk: Admin enumeration. Recurring finding — previous fixes have regressed.
gaps.fix_shape: Column-scoped grant or a profiles_public view; must survive the next scan.

gaps.title: MAPPLS_CLIENT_ID / MAPPLS_CLIENT_SECRET are referenced by mappls-geo but not configured
gaps.evidence: Secret diff: both keys referenced in supabase/functions/mappls-geo/index.ts, neither present in project secrets.
gaps.risk: India geocoding degraded or failing silently for Rides/Scout.
gaps.note: mappls-geo is on the do-not-touch list for edits; this is a credentials gap, not a code gap.

gaps.title: Study — the most-used feature in the database — is absent from the Play listing
gaps.evidence: 1164 chapters, 154 tutor messages, 87 papers, 67 quiz attempts, 16 learner profiles; zero mention on Play.
gaps.risk: Lost acquisition; also an education/minors surface that the listing's data-safety narrative does not describe.

gaps.title: Website labels Jobs 'Coming soon' while 25 CVs have been generated in production
gaps.evidence: oniqhub.com Jobs tile text vs cv_documents=25, cv_attestations=25.

gaps.title: Site advertises ONIQ Learn lessons; learn_courses / learn_lessons / learn_questions are all empty
/q/<token> is not in the Android app-links intent filter and no tokens have ever been issued
Creator payouts cannot be initiated — RAZORPAYX_ACCOUNT_NUMBER unset, payout tables empty
In-chat translation shipped but message_translations has 0 rows
gaps.evidence: Table empty despite translate-message being deployed and gated per conversation.

gaps.title: Six edge functions have no client caller
gaps.evidence: flight-search, send-otp, verify-otp, check-user-exists, find-friends, turn-creds (turn-creds is PROTECTED — leave alone).
gaps.risk: Attack surface and maintenance cost with no user value.

gaps.title: The assessment_* family (4 tables) and ai_chats/ai_messages have zero rows and zero source references
gaps.evidence: Row counts 0; grep finds no references in src.

gaps.title: Seven tables have RLS enabled with no policies at all
gaps.evidence: api_budget, copyright_notices, otp_attempts, profile_qr_tokens, story_dispatch_health, study_chapters_debug, study_papers.
gaps.risk: Not a leak. But study_papers holds 87 rows, so confirm every read path is a SECURITY DEFINER RPC.

gaps.title: A public MCP tool surface (/mcp, /.mcp/list-tools, /.mcp/invoke-tool) ships with the app and is described nowhere
gaps.evidence: Routes present in src/routes; /mcp-signin returns 307 on production.

gaps.evidence: Zero inbound links; the component comment records the extraction.
